selection.chinese_to_english: One subtitle: an unqualified English word, else a short phrase, else a truncated gloss. Archaic, slang, dialect, and similar labels lose to a plain sense. Not reused as the English index.
selection.english_phrases: Two-to-four-word glosses, stored separately. The same frequency prior applies. The one-word English composer does not look them up.
selection.english_to_chinese: Separate headword index. A labeled archaic or slang sense loses. Otherwise the earlier CC-CEDICT gloss wins, and the vendored rime-essay score breaks remaining ties. This is not a reversal of the Chinese subtitle table.
selection.frequency_prior: data/plum/essay.txt from the already vendored rime-essay package. Scores are baked into the index and are not read on the key path.
selection.skipped_glosses: surname, variant, see, classifier, and abbreviation glosses
